:::{.callout-learning}
After completing this session, you will be able to:

- Practice creating an R Project
- Organize an R Project for effective project management
- Understand how to move in an R Project using paths and working directories
:::

## Overview

In this lesson you will log on to the RStudio Server, create an R Project, and organize it with sub-directories.  You will also learn how paths and working directories work, so that you can move around in your R Project.
